user.title: Set up Sharing Is Caring
user.description: Share sanitized automations and scripts with their related helpers. Provide your own GitHub Personal Access Token (Fine-Grained with 'Gists: Read and write' only, or Classic with 'gist' scope only) to publish shareable Gist URLs, or leave it blank for Local Copy & Download mode.

data.show_in_sidebar: Show Sharing Is Caring in the sidebar (admins only)

data_description.github_token: Stored locally in Home Assistant and used only when you click Publish. Needs Gist permission only — zero repository access.
data_description.default_visibility: Secret Gists are unlisted and accessible only to people with the link.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: Adds a dedicated 3-step share wizard to the Home Assistant sidebar for admin users.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sharing Is Caring
reconfigure.description: Update or remove your GitHub Personal Access Token. Leave blank to switch to Local Copy & Download mode only.

error.invalid_auth: GitHub rejected this token (401). Check that the token is valid and not expired.
error.insufficient_scope: This token does not have Gist permission. Enable 'Gists: Read and write' (Fine-Grained PAT) or the 'gist' scope (Classic PAT).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach api.github.com. Check your Home Assistant internet connectivity and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating GitHub credentials.

abort.already_configured: Sharing Is Caring is already configured.

data.show_in_sidebar: Show Sharing Is Caring in the sidebar (admins only)
